title: Director Payment Integrity
description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes, and we rarely outsource recruitment.

HyPlus ist Dein Wegbegleiter im digitalen Wandel. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickeln wir strukturiert, partnerschaftlich und mit klarem Fokus auf nachhaltigen Mehrwert, deren digitale DNA. Wir begleiten Unternehmen von der Anforderungsanalyse über Architektur, Softwareentwicklung und Implementierung bis hin zum Betrieb. Mit rund 800 Kolleg:innen in Deutschland, Polen, Litauen, Rumänien und Indien verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit Branchenkompetenz in Automotive, Handel, Banken & Versicherungen sowie dem öffentlichen Sektor.

Bei uns ist KI kein Innovationstheater. Wir betreiben einen eigenen GPU-Server, hosten Modelle selbst, betreiben einen eigenen AI Gateway und bauen für Kunden – insb. aus der Versicherungswirtschaft - Prozesse, die täglich echte Fälle entscheiden. Unser Center of Excellence AI ist die Stelle, an der neue Technologien zuerst ankommen, bewertet und dann in Projekte und in eine Guidance für unsere Mitarbeitenden übersetzt werden.

Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der/die wirklich tief drin ist: eine Person, die neue Modelle, Frameworks und Werkzeuge früh entdeckt, sie selbst ausprobiert und danach begründen kann, was davon in einem regulierten Unternehmensumfeld trägt und was nicht. Ungefähr 70 % der Zeit arbeitest du direkt in Kundenprojekten, rund 30 % gehören dem Center of Excellence (CoE) und damit der Frage, wo wir in achtzehn Monaten stehen.

Deine Aufgaben in Kundenprojekten:

  • Agentische Prozessautomatisierung: Du entwirfst und entwickelst Agenten und Workflows entlang realer Fachprozesse, beispielsweise für Schadenmeldungen, Dokumentenprüfungen oder Kunden-Onboarding, und entscheidest, wann KI oder klassische Logik sinnvoll ist

  • LLM- und Bild-KI-Module: Du integrierst Text-, Dokumenten- und Bildverarbeitung als API-basierte Module in produktive Anwendungen und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Datenanreicherung

  • Betrieb, Sicherheit und Compliance: Du verantwortest das Hosting von KI-Modellen auf eigener GPU-Infrastruktur sowie den AI Gateway und berücksichtigst Datenschutz, Sicherheit und EU AI Act

  • Inferenz-Betrieb und AI-DevOps: Du betreibst und optimierst offene KI-Modelle mit Technologien wie Ollama, vLLM, SGLang und TGI sowie Docker und Kubernetes und verantwortest automatisierte Deployments, Monitoring und Kostenkontrolle

  • Sparring im Presales: Du begleitest Kundentermine und Workshops, berätst Fachbereiche und bewertest technische Möglichkeiten, Kosten und Risiken

  • Befähigung in die Breite: Du vermittelst dein Wissen durch Schulungen, Demos und praxisnahe Leitlinien an unsere Mitarbeitenden

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Senior Platform Engineer

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

 

Our Mission For You

European energy costs are twice as high as in the US and China, and electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure – and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast – the market window is open and we intend to own it.

Now we are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to build the foundation every trawa engineer relies on.

 

About trawa

trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you.

 

The Team

Our Platform team owns our infrastructure, shared tooling and developer experience, so your work shapes how fast and how safely the whole company ships. You'll work with engineers across the company and see the impact of your work across every team.

 

Who We Are Looking For

  • Impact focus: You focus on impact, not just technical outcomes, and you care about what your work makes possible for others.

  • Natural collaborator: People enjoy working with you, and you build strong relationships across teams.

  • Platform experience: You have at least 8 years of experience in a platform, DevOps or SRE role.

  • Hands-on AWS and IaC: You have deep hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform.

  • Distributed systems: You have built or run distributed services in production, with a strong grasp of security, reliability, observability and cost efficiency.

 

What You'll Do

  • Build and run scalable, secure, highly available AWS infrastructure that powers our mission-critical services.

  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling and internal platforms so teams ship faster and with confidence.

  • Embed security into our infrastructure and pipelines, covering access management, secrets and compliance needs.

  • Partner with engineers, share best practices and make the right way the easy way.

 

Our Tech Stack

  • AWS, Terraform, Spacelift, Docker, GitHub Actions

  • Python, TypeScript

  • Dash0, Sentry, Incident.io

 

90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • Current setup: You have a comprehensive understanding of trawa's current tech stack, infrastructure and security posture.

  • Team relationships: You have met the engineering teams, learned how they build, ship and run their services, and developed relationships with your key stakeholders.

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • Infrastructure ownership: You own parts of our AWS infrastructure and Terraform codebase.

  • Workflow friction: You have found the biggest friction points in our developer workflow and proposed ways to fix them.

  • Platform improvement: You have led a meaningful platform improvement from design to rollout.

 

Why Us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity – most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your work will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

title: Sales Specialist/in – Steuerberatung neu gedacht (m/w/d)
description:
Du hörst gerne zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und machst aus Interesse eine gute Entscheidung? Dann hilf uns, neue Mandant:innen für b’steuern zu gewinnen.

Täglich erreichen uns Menschen, die ihre Steuerberatung verändern wollen. Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen und Unternehmen, die sich digitale Abläufe, klare Preise und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit wünschen.

Deine Aufgabe: verstehen, was sie brauchen, unser Angebot verständlich machen und sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Entscheidung begleiten.

Über uns

b’steuern ist keine klassische Kanzlei.

Wir beraten Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen, Interim Manager:innen und Unternehmen bis 100 Mio. Euro Umsatz. Dabei arbeiten wir voll digital, entwickeln eigene Tech- und KI-Lösungen und hinterfragen konsequent, was Steuerberatung unnötig kompliziert macht.

Unser Ziel: So einfach wie möglich für alle Beteiligten – mit der Kraft von Tech und KI.

Was uns besonders macht:

  • Radikal digital: Wir setzen auf moderne Software, KI und eigene Tech-Lösungen, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren.

  • Radikal kundenfokussiert: Unsere Mandant:innen bekommen transparente Pakete, klare Preise und verständliche Kommunikation.

  • Radikal selbstorganisiert: Unsere Teams übernehmen Verantwortung und gestalten ihre Zusammenarbeit aktiv mit.

  • Remote-first: Wir arbeiten verteilt und haben ein Office in Berlin-Mitte.

  • Ambitioniertes Wachstum: Wir wollen die Steuerberatung grundlegend weiterentwickeln – und suchen Menschen, die diese Reise mitgestalten.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die erste persönliche Stimme, die neue Mandant:innen bei b’steuern hören.

Unsere Interessent:innen haben sich bereits bewusst bei uns gemeldet. Du greifst ihr Interesse auf und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen heraus, ob unser Angebot zu ihrem Bedarf passt.

In einem 30-minütigen Video-Call lernst du sie und ihr Unternehmen kennen, erfasst ihre Ausgangslage und erstellst live ein passendes Angebot. Du erklärst unsere Leistungen, beantwortest Fragen und machst die nächsten Schritte klar.

Auch danach bleibst du dran: Du fasst freundlich nach, koordinierst offene Punkte und sorgst bei einer Zusage für eine gute Übergabe an unser Onboarding-Team. Fachliche Fragen klärst du gemeinsam mit unseren Steuerprofis.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kennenlerngespräche führen: Du sprichst in 30-minütigen Video-Calls mit Interessent:innen und verstehst ihre Situation, Erwartungen und Bedürfnisse.

  • Angebote live erstellen: Du stellst passende Leistungen zusammen und erklärst transparent, was enthalten ist und was sie kosten.

  • Entscheidungen begleiten: Du beantwortest Rückfragen, klärst Details und fasst verbindlich nach, wenn noch etwas offen ist.

  • Telefonisch unterstützen: Du bist auch außerhalb der Video-Calls ansprechbar und hilfst Interessent:innen beim nächsten Schritt.

  • CRM zuverlässig pflegen: Du dokumentierst Gespräche, hältst Informationen aktuell und behältst Angebote und Follow-ups im Blick.

  • Übergaben organisieren: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team und unseren Steuerberater:innen zusammen, damit neue Mandant:innen gut bei uns starten.

  • Abläufe verbessern: Du bringst Erfahrungen aus deinen Gesprächen ein und hilfst uns, Angebote, Kommunikation und Sales-Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln.

Was du mitbringst

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, fragst gezielt nach und erklärst verständlich. Im Video-Call und am Telefon trittst du freundlich und sicher auf.

  • Verständnis für Unternehmertum: Du kannst dich in Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen und Unternehmer:innen hineinversetzen und interessierst dich für ihren Alltag.

  • Neugier auf steuerliche Themen: USt-Voranmeldung, EÜR oder Bilanz musst du zum Einstieg nicht im Detail beherrschen. Du willst aber verstehen, worum es geht und welche Fragen du an unsere Steuerprofis weitergibst.

  • Struktur und Verbindlichkeit: CRM-Pflege, gute Gesprächsnotizen und zuverlässige Follow-ups gehören für dich zu einer professionellen Kundenbeziehung.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du organisierst deine Arbeit, setzt Prioritäten und bringst offene Themen zum Abschluss.

  • Technologisches Interesse: Du arbeitest gerne mit digitalen Tools und hast Lust, KI sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag einzubauen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

title: Commercial Counsel - Germany
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our Legal Team in Germany. In this role, you will support complex commercial transactions with a primary focus on Germany and support for the DACH region, including SaaS, licensing, and strategic partnerships, while helping the company navigate diverse legal and regulatory frameworks in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. You will work closely with global colleagues to provide practical, business-oriented advice that enables growth while managing risk across multiple jurisdictions.

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate enterprise commercial agreements, with a primary focus on GTM/Sales transactions in Germany, with support for EMEA as a whole, as a member of a growing commercial legal team in the regions.

  • Partner with sales, business development, and operations teams to design and implement strategies that support high-growth go-to-market initiatives.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving country specific legal and regulatory developments, including data protection, technology, and AI-related frameworks, and apply this knowledge to contract drafting and risk assessment.

  • Develop, maintain, and localize contract templates, playbooks, and policies to reflect local requirements and industry best practices.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused legal advice to cross-functional teams, tailoring advice to enable responsible growth and innovation.

  • Contribute to scaling the Legal Team’s commercial function, fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture.

Who you are

  • Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, have a strong sense of ownership with enthusiasm for applying your legal expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • Experienced in navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments, with the ability to manage ambiguity and make informed, timely decisions.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global colleagues.

  • Proactive, business-minded, and committed to delivering practical solutions that support both compliance and commercial success.

  • Hunger to be exceptional at your job.

What you bring

  • Law degree and qualification to practice law in Germany.

  • Native-level German and fluent English.

  • 7+ years of relevant post-qualification legal experience (in-house experience in technology or SaaS strongly preferred).

  • Proven track record drafting and negotiating complex commercial and technology agreements.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise software licensing, SaaS, data protection, and intellectual property.

  • Experience advising on privacy, cybersecurity, and cross-border data transfer issues.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and tight deadlines

Location

This role is remote, so it can be executed from anywhere in Germany.

A bit about the finance function at Luminovo

Over the last 4 years, Luminovo has grown on a 73% compounding growth rate. Throughout this time, Luminovo’s Finance team has consisted of never more than 1.5-2 FTE and a part-time leader (Benedikt). We love to overwhelm our financial service providers with demands for better API and are often leading our Claude’s lines-of-code company dashboards.

Your role

Build a finance function that scales through better systems, not a bigger team.

We’re making our finance leadership a full-time role. You’ll lead and coach a team of two while staying close to the work: accounts, cash, reporting and the systems behind them. We want a finance operator who enjoys building with code and AI, not just introducing new tools.

  • Own daily closing across our organisations on at least two continents. Improve the automation and controls behind it, whether the system is already running or still needs work when you join.

  • Build automatic financial feedback loops across Luminovo. Give leaders the information they need where they work, and use code and AI to automate routine decisions so people can focus on complex judgement.

  • Keep shareholders and lenders informed with timely, accurate reporting they can trust.

  • Protect our cash position. Own the connection between forecasts and reality across payables, receivables, treasury and working capital.

  • Help colleagues make better financial decisions. Coach team leads and company leadership on returns, trade-offs and the opportunity cost of each investment.

  • Lead, coach and mentor your team of two. Grow the team’s capabilities and the quality of our systems rather than relying on more headcount.

What you bring

This is a full-time role with a minimum of five days per month in our Munich office. Being based permanently in Munich is preferred but not required.

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker.

  • Attraktives Jahresgehalt von €55.000–65.000 brutto.

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Customer Success Manager – Performance Marketing / MarTech (w/m/d).

description:
About the team:

The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.

We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.

We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.

 

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.
  • Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users.
  • Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.
  • Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.
  • Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.

 

You'll be great for this role if you have:

  • Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems.
  • Excitement for security and reliability topics. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g. OAuth, Multi-Factor Authentication) would be nice to have.
  • A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment and navigate complex domains. You are a quick learner and have a proven ability to pick up new skills and concepts swiftly.
  • A structured, proactive way of working. You enjoy working independently but also effectively collaborate with your cross-functional team and other teams.
  • A natural drive to improve things—you're always looking to make systems and processes better. You strive for great solutions, but also know when to be pragmatic.
  • Confidence in asking for help or using available tools (like search engines or AI assistants) when something is beyond your grasp.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written. As part of a globally distributed team, clear and respectful communication is essential.

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖️ Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🍽️ Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

title: Senior Product Manager, LiveOps – Idle Bank Tycoon (f/m/d)
description:
We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.

Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Senior Product Manager, LiveOps – Idle Bank Tycoon (f/m/d)

Idle Bank Tycoon (IBT) lets players around the world build their own banking empire, one upgrade at a time. As Senior Product Manager, you’llown the Live side of Idle Bank Tycoon (IBT), from strategy to execution, and you’ll be responsible for the game’s Live performance.
Our Lead Designer owns feature design and the macro economy. You and your team own the numbers behind it: you set the costs and rewards of every game element, in both soft and hard currency, and keep them well-tuned for as long as the game runs.
You’ll report to the Head of Game and work closely with the Producer and the Lead Designer. You’ll bring the right data into every conversation so the team can make good choices together.

Responsibilities
  • Manage and grow the Live squad of Idle Bank Tycoon, a cross-functional team that includes a game economy designer and an analyst
  • Shape the Live strategy and roadmap (events, offers, economy tuning). Set the LiveOps vision and goals with your team, and take Live events and offers from idea to launch
  • Be responsible for the Live economy and its balancing. Define and fine-tune the costs, rewards and prices of all game elements (features, upgrades, events, offers) in soft and hard currency, from launch values to ongoing balancing, and set up Live events and offers in our live content tool
  • Turn each new feature’s design into concrete cost and reward values that fit the economy and the Live roadmap
  • Keep a close eye on game metrics, dig into KPIs and recommend improvements that support long-term LTV. Get to know different player audiences and build segments with tailored balancing and offers
  • Run A/B and multivariate tests on the economy, events and offers to improve retention, conversion and monetization while reducing friction
  • Collaborate on KPI dashboards, and help us work out which tools and systems we need to build or improve so we can make the best in-game choices
  • Study the economies and live operations of games in relevant subgenres, and share practical insights with senior stakeholders and the wider team

    • Required Skills
  • 5+ years in mobile F2P product, including at least one Live game at scale
  • Experience shaping the Live strategy of a similar mobile F2P game, ideally in the idle / tycoon genre
  • Hands-on experience running a LiveOps / event calendar, from planning to performance review
  • Experience managing a cross-functional Live team (economy design, analytics) and delivering improvements step by step, together
  • Experience A/B testing economy, event and offer assumptions to improve KPIs
  • Hands-on experience with BI and experimentation tools (e.g. Looker, Amplitude), and turning complex data into clear, practical recommendations that grow revenue
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative way of working

    • Desirable Skills
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Google Play Console and App Store Connect
  • Experience with economy design in hybrid monetization (IAP and Ads), ideally for idle or tycoon games

We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability.

    We look forward to hearing from you!

    Competitive Salary - We believe that top performers should receive top payment
    Learning Budget - We believe in learning. A generous personal learning budget to spend on learning and development, including books, workshops and attending conferences. We also offer in-house training such as coding and German classes
    Flexible Working Hours and Home Office – We believe in a good work-life balance

title: Senior Controller (m/f/x)
description:
Your Role

As a Senior Controller, you take a key role in steering FINN’s financial performance. You deep-dive into P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow performance, explain variances against plan and identify the underlying drivers, with a particular focus on Gross Margin and unit economics. You translate data-driven insights into clear, actionable recommendations that help leadership steer the business. In addition, you contribute to our Group Management Reporting under HGB & IFRS and drive process and system improvements to scale with FINN’s growth.


Your Mission

  • Contribute to Management Reporting: Translate monthly and year-end closing accounts (HGB & IFRS) into an insightful Group Management Reporting for P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Statement, targeting internal leadership, board, shareholders, and banks. Provide clear commentary on business performance and financial variance analysis against the plan, while continuously helping to develop the structure and content of the Management Reporting.

  • Analyze Performance & Business Drivers: Deep-dive into financial and operational data to analyze P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow performance, and identify deviations against plan, the drivers of cost, revenue and cash flow, and their underlying root causes.

  • Steer Gross Margin & Unit Economics: Own the analysis of Gross Margin P&L line items and unit economics, providing transparency on planned and actual profitability per subscription. Partner with leadership and business owners to evaluate financial trade-offs based on data-driven insights, for example in demand and supply steering, and to implement and track initiatives that improve profitability.

  • Improve Processes & Systems: Drive company-wide process improvements, for example strengthening and aligning the monthly provisions process, and system improvements, such as setting up analyses in Lucanet or SAP-based cost center reporting, to improve the accuracy and transparency of our monthly financials.

description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.


About the role:

As Upvest continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional SME Trading Infrastructure. You will work closely with Götz Röhr, Pim Hannay and the Brokerage Product & Engineering Leadership team. In addition you will need to build strong relations with the Operations, Banking and Commercial teams, driving topics critical to Upvest's success.

What you can expect from this role:

  • Impact and influence, laying the foundations on how one of Europe's leading infrastructure companies builds their trading infrastructure.

  • Product-centricity throughout the organisation, with no struggle for relevance that product people may encounter elsewhere.

  • Autonomy and ownership. You run your topics and are trusted to drive them to results.

  • Being part of a group of experts, all having their own areas of expertise but working strongly together.

  • Continuous learning across investments, API products, and modern product operations.

What you’ll do:

Develop upvest's future trading infrastructure

You will drive the strategy to evolve and scale our trading infrastructure in line with our company strategy. You will own and support the decisions that shape it: which execution venues to connect in which markets, which assets and order types to support next, how to initiate post-trade, where to expand and, just as importantly, where not to. You will weigh client needs, market structure, cost, and regulatory requirements to place the right bets at the right time. The goal: a trading infrastructure that fits our clients' needs and growing expectations perfectly, built through fast, confident decisions and a focus on outcomes.

Accelerate our trading initiatives

You will drive the initiatives that matter to Upvest’s success: big trading bets, new venues and CCP connectivities, and the products and procedures our clients need to trade across Europe. You bring an up-to-date understanding of the European trading landscape (exchanges, MTFs and Systematic Internalisers, CCPs and their connectivity, and how it all links into clearing, settlement and custody) and use it to assess market places, their propositions, and where they are heading. You will develop our long-term trading infrastructure strategy and guide its execution: shaping trading and migration strategies for clients, running RfPs for potential partners where needed, and enabling the Product organisation to deliver the right results quickly.


What you bring:

  • 4+ years in investment banking, product management, trading operations, at a financial institution or SaaS-company with the focus on trading infrastructure.

  • Deep knowledge and understanding of market infrastructures, exchanges, CCPs and others, the connectivity options and current developments

  • Proven ability to also understand client expectations and connect this to possibilities given by external trading infrastructures.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write a crisp memo, highlighting different opportunities, and present to executives and boards.

  • Proven ability to drive alignment and progress across teams without formal authority.


How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Overview of the Role

You will build the Site Reliability Engineering function at Zego, embedding reliability, observability and operational excellence as core engineering concerns - AI is the primary lever for doing that at scale, not a bolt on.

  • You will be our dedicated SRE, working alongside Systems Engineering and embedded with Product and Engineering across roughly 120 engineers. Teams own their services and their own on-call. You own the framework, the instrumentation and the AI tooling that makes that ownership work.

  • You will make teams good at running what they build: alert quality over alert volume, runbooks an agent can execute rather than prose that describes, and diagnostics good enough that an engineer or an agent reaches resolution without an SRE in the room.

  • You will be the primary advocate for reliability with Product and Engineering, making the case with data rather than assertion, so platform health is prioritised alongside delivery commitments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and land the reliability standard: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and production readiness criteria that teams apply to their own services, with adoption measured rather than assumed.

  • Encode standards into automation rather than enforcing them by hand. Guardrails in CI, agents that check reliability and observability posture on pull requests, and safe defaults in shared infrastructure so the reliable path is the easy path.

  • Build SRE capability on Zego's AI platform, extending our MCP servers and agents, and making the estate legible to them through machine readable runbooks, structured telemetry and diagnostics an agent can act on.

  • Own observability as a practice, including instrumentation design, signal quality, cardinality and cost.

  • Raise the standard of incident response end-to-end, from detection and triage through to retrospectives that produce change. Put AI to work where it pays off most, stripping toil out of incidents so responders can focus on judgement

  • Measure toil, publish it, and remove it through tooling that others can run without you.

What you will need to be successful in the Role

We are looking for an engineer who lives SRE and DevOps culture, and treats AI tooling as a default part of how the work gets done, not a side experiment. You will engage and empower teams through decisions grounded in data, and you will be as comfortable building with AI as consuming it: extending MCP servers, writing agents, and automating the operational work that would otherwise fill your week. We treat reliability at Zego as a platform capability, so we care more about what you can make repeatable for others than what you can fix yourself.

What you’ll bring to the Team

  • Deep SRE experience: SLI and SLO definition, error budget management, and ownership of incident response through to blameless retrospectives.

  • Fluency with AI as an engineering tool rather than a chat window: building agents and automation, working with MCP servers or equivalent, and judgement about where an agent can act and where a human stays in the loop.

  • Strong software engineering in Python, writing tested, maintainable code that other engineers can run and extend.

  • Observability depth with OpenTelemetry and Datadog.

  • AWS at scale, and Kubernetes based platforms managed through Infrastructure as Code.

Desirable

  • Istio, Crossplane and ArgoCD. We run all three and will teach the specifics to the right person.

  • Running ML or AI workloads in production, such as model serving or feature pipelines. We do this at Zego and you would help support it.

  • Having been a sole delivery owner somewhere, and knowing what that does and does not mean.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

title: Head of IT & Security
description:

Backed by General Catalyst, the investors behind companies like Stripe and Airbnb, we're building something extraordinary.


Our Mission 🌎

At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do.

As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale.

We do this in two ways:

  • Goodstack for Business helps some of the world's leading companies power their social impact programmes.

  • Goodstack for Causes helps nonprofits access the funding, technology and resources they need to thrive.

And we're already making a difference:

  • $11 billion in donations facilitated since 2022.

  • Over 13 million mission-driven organisations in the world's largest verified database.

  • 500,000+ nonprofits on our platform, with thousands more joining every week.

  • Trusted by global companies including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Open AI, Canva, TikTok and Airbnb, alongside nonprofits such as the Red Cross, Cancer Research UK and Oxfam.


What We're Building Next 🚀

We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide.

By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently.

Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems.

That's where you come in 🫵

Join us as Head of IT & Security to help our teams support nonprofits with confidence!

We’re looking for a practical, technically credible Head of IT & Security to own and improve the systems, services and controls that help Goodstack work effectively and securely.

You’ll set the direction, make decisions and deliver changes, leading a small, hands-on team. From improving how colleagues get equipment and access to leading our information-security programme, you’ll connect the details to the wider business and make clear trade-offs around risk, productivity, cost and culture.

If you enjoy building a function, developing others and taking improvements from an idea through to a working result, this is an opportunity to shape IT and security in a business helping nonprofits access technology and funding. Working with the VP of Architecture & Infrastructure, you’ll develop the function’s capabilities as Goodstack grows.

As Head of IT and Security, your mission will be to:

  • Own IT and security strategy and delivery. Assess our environment, set priorities and deliver improvements alongside your team. Balance security, productivity, cost and culture while meeting customer commitments. Own the roadmap, budget and risk register, making pragmatic decisions, explaining trade-offs and escalating material risks with recommendations.

  • Build IT that scales with Goodstack. Own identity, devices, SaaS, office technology and employee lifecycle processes. Work with People, Finance, Operations and managers to improve the complete employee experience, remove cross-team friction and reduce manual effort without weakening controls.

  • Lead and develop the function. Set direction, coach technical judgement and support complex work while remaining hands-on. Ensure reliable support coverage and protect time for improvements. Anticipate capability gaps and recommend training, tooling, specialist support or hiring.

  • Own security, compliance and assurance. Lead ISO 27001 and SOC 2, ensuring policies, controls, audits and evidence are maintained year-round. Work with Engineering on application and cloud risks, including XSS, access controls and configuration weaknesses, ensuring remediation is prioritised and verified.

  • Find weaknesses before they cause harm. Challenge assumptions through threat modelling, authorised security testing, incident exercises and recovery tests. Turn findings into preventive improvements, verify their effectiveness and coordinate security incidents when needed.

  • Build a culture of secure working. Make secure behaviour the easiest choice. Understand why shortcuts happen, improve processes and incentives, provide practical training and encourage early reporting. Help colleagues navigate decisions where the right answer isn't obvious.

  • Own vendors and security relationships. Manage suppliers, licences, renewals, service quality, spend and continuity plans. Coordinate vendor risk, contractual security requirements, subprocessors and privacy operations with Legal, the DPO and business owners. Represent Goodstack in customer security reviews and with auditors and assessors.

  • Lead AI governance and enablement. Own our ISO/IEC 42001 programme, coordinating risk assessments, controls, audit readiness and responsible AI requirements across teams. Establish safeguards for data, access, evaluation and human oversight. Help colleagues adopt approved AI tools safely through guidance, training and pilots, measuring proficiency and impact while department leaders own adoption outcomes.

  • Make IT smarter through automation. Identify recurring problems, employee time lost and avoidable manual work. Choose between simplifying processes, existing tools, deterministic workflows and AI based on risk, value and maintenance cost. Design and review complex automations, measure improvements and ensure appropriate testing, monitoring, exception handling and human oversight.

  • Build a function that doesn't depend on individuals. Establish clear ownership, documentation, recovery procedures and organisation-managed credentials. Ensure critical workflows survive staff departures and can be maintained by others. Use service metrics and operational feedback to continually improve priorities.

After 3, 6 and 9 months, success will look like:

  • 3 months: You've assessed the environment, agreed a prioritised roadmap and delivered initial improvements. Key risks, controls, audit commitments and findings have clear owners. Service baselines are established, and the scope and gaps for ISO/IEC 42001 are understood.

  • 6 months: Routine IT runs reliably without your daily involvement. Measurable improvements show reduced manual effort, delays, and errors without weakening controls. Critical automations have tested recovery arrangements, and initial AI enablement work demonstrates progress. Evidence informs what to continue, simplify, or stop.

  • 9 months: Improvements are sustained, recurring problems are addressed at their source, and leadership has a clear view of risk, spend and priorities. Security exercises and feedback drive prevention, critical workflows can be maintained by others, and you're independently shaping the function's next stage.

  • You've found the stash of sock merch in the office 🧦

This role is a perfect match for you if you have:

  • Experience owning IT and information security in a growing technology business, with a track record of personally delivering improvements.

  • Strong knowledge of identity, devices, SaaS and workplace IT, alongside enough application and cloud security expertise to challenge and collaborate with engineers.

  • Led ISO 27001 or SOC 2 through assessment and ongoing operation, with the ability to manage both.

  • Excellent judgement balancing security, usability, cost and business needs, including identifying root causes and making decisions under uncertainty.

  • Experience leading and developing colleagues while remaining technically hands-on.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence behaviour, resolve ambiguity and build practical working relationships.

  • Experience delivering reliable automation using scripts, workflows or AI, with sound judgement on security, testing, failure handling, maintainability and measurable impact.

Bonus if you have knowledge or love of:

  • AWS, Google Workspace, Slack, Kandji or Vanta.

  • n8n, API integrations or AI-assisted workflows.

You'll join our R&D department, over 200 people across London, Ireland and Malaga, working in cross-functional teams helping to build the Quantexa Platform, our core Contextual Decision Intelligence offering. Our technology helps customers tackle complex challenges across fraud detection, financial crime, data management and more.

What you'll be doing.

title: Post-Silicon Validation Team Leader
description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

You will lead Fractile’s Post-Silicon Validation team, taking first silicon from power-on to a fully characterised, working product. The team sits within the Architecture group and owns functional validation (bring-up) and characterisation of new silicon as it returns from manufacture, enabling the system-level product bring-up. You will build validation and characterisation content under simulation ahead of first silicon, deploy and debug it on the real devices, and drive the test infrastructure and methodology the whole programme depends on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor and provide technical direction to the Post-Silicon Validation team

  • Plan, design, develop and debug silicon validation and characterisation tests on pre-silicon platforms ahead of first silicon

  • Deploy and debug validation and characterisation tests on first silicon, from initial bring-up through to full functional coverage and silicon characterisation

  • Develop automated test frameworks and regression suites to raise validation throughput

  • Architect and drive continuous improvement of test infrastructure, methodology and processes

  • Analyse test results, isolate failures and root-cause defects across hardware, firmware and software boundaries

  • Enable and support production systems, firmware and software teams through their bring-up

  • Contribute to shared test and validation infrastructure used across the programme

  • Feed findings back to architects and designers to shape future silicon

  • Report programme status and progress to programme management

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in post-silicon validation in digital ASIC environments

  • Experience in characterisation, failure analysis, test development, statistical analysis

  • Experience leading or technically directing a validation or test engineering team

  • Strong low-level, system software development

  • Excellent working knowledge of digital ASIC design and architecture

  • Ability to work across teams, abstraction layers and programming languages to root-cause deep and complex issues

  • Strong system debug, log analysis and failure isolation skills

  • Ability to drive cross-functional work and communicate clearly with engineering and programme management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Driver-level experience with PCIe, memory technologies (LPDDR, DDR, HBM) or peripherals such as I2C, I3C and SPI

  • Knowledge of mixed-signal building blocks — PLLs, high-speed PHYs — and on-chip control and communication protocols

  • Experience with RISC-V CPUs, system IP and associated debug tooling

  • Experience with AMBA protocols

  • Understanding of ML applications and their workloads

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.
